notes.title: Fixed Tutorials bug!
notes.content:
Hey friends!

We fixed a couple of bugs over the weekend, and made a couple small improvements. They’re listed below!

* [b]Major bug fix: a bug occurred during the Introduction and Tagging tutorials where the avatar would fail to type on the keyboard, and this would render the application unusable.[/b]
* We added a “Skip Instructions” button so that you can skip the instructions phase of a Tutorial!
* We added an arrow to the Tutorials that indicates which Tutorial is up next.
* We added a color indicator to the Primary Controller that appears when you’re using the Draw Tool. This indicator tells you which color you’re drawing with.
